items.title: Home Depot (HD) Names Richard McPhail CEO In Sweeping Leadership Reshuffle
items.summary: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) appointed current CFO Richard McPhail as chief executive officer as Ted Decker steps down after medical leave. Ann-Marie Campbell was named President and chief operating officer, expanding her responsibility across the retailer’s global operations. Jordan Broggi will move into the chief financial officer role, completing a broad leadership reshuffle at the home improvement chain. items.title: Eli Lilly Caught in Vendor Hack as Extortion Group Threatens to Leak Data on 1.2 Million Patients
items.summary: Lilly found no unauthorized access to its own systems, a person familiar with the matter said. Extortion group n0n claims to hold patient and prescriber data.

items.title: Disney Up on Adjusted EPS Beat; Home Depot Down on Guidance | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Disney (DIS) shares are rising after the media company reported adjusted earnings per share for the fourth quarter that beat the average analyst estimate. - Home Depot (HD) shares are lower despite quarterly earnings beating estimates. It comes after the retailer adjusted its year guidance, which analysts say implies a deceleration for the fourth quarter. - Red Cat Holdings (RCAT) shares sliding after the company said it no longer expects to achieve its full-year revenue target and reported third-quarter results that missed the average analyst estimate on key metrics.
